description: Estimates wedding bar quantities from guest count, event duration and drink mix, with bottles and cases rounded up. Quantities follow planning rules of thumb and are not a guarantee of consumption. This tool does not purchase alcohol.

champagne_toast.description: Whether the estimate includes one flute of champagne per guest for a toast. Default: true.

crowd.description: How much the crowd drinks (default: average)

mix.description: Bar mix across wine, beer, and spirits (default: balanced)

name: get_alcohol_estimate
title: Wedding Alcohol Calculator
